kind: STUDY MANIFEST — frozen before any development performance result of L1 or L2; never edited (changes go to AMENDMENTS.md)

arms.L0: the current model (exact control): a refused Growth entry proceeds as an unfunded virtual position; freed capital never revives it (Priority 3 evaluate.ts run, unchanged)
arms.L1: Growth responds to actual funding: a refused request leaves the book flat (decision-time transitions canonical, no order, no position); no retry; later entries only from fresh canonical decisions
arms.L2: L1 plus one retained refused BASE opportunity per Growth book (continuation refusals stay L1), reassessed at each completed signal bar while flat, after the canonical decisions of the instant

interpretation.R1: per lifecycle, the Pareto set of {E, C4, C85, A, B} on centre net ↑, centre DD ↓, confirmation p10 net ↑, confirmation p90 DD ↓
interpretation.R2: per subject, median paired Δnet and Δ p90 DD on the confirmation draws: helps / mixed / hurts / hurts (tail risk) / helps (tail risk) / little with ±$2,500 bands (report-only)
interpretation.R3: admission of GDX Growth: (A − C4), (B − C85), (GP4 − S4), (GP85 − S85) at the centre: net, VGT Growth booked, D1 booked; L1/L2 vs L0
interpretation.R4: E against A, B, C4, C85 per lifecycle: dominance on the four objectives; E non-dominated or not
interpretation.R5: standalone: retention p10/centre net and inflation p90 DD/centre DD on the common instrument; stronger iff better on both
interpretation.R6: an arm deserves 3B optimization (provisional) iff labelled helps* vs L0 for ≥ 2 of {A, B, GP4, GP85} and hurts* for none of the nine core Growth subjects
